test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 04 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.

Don't you be clever with me, boy! I want to know what you're really ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence requires a phrase that aligns with the context of suspicion or inquiry into someone's real intentions or activities.
 
• The phrase **"up to"** fits the context and means engaged in something, especially something secret or improper.
 
• **"What you're really up to" **implies a question about what the person is truly planning or doing.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is:* "Don't you be clever with me, boy! I want to know what you're really up to." *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1:** "on to"** doesn't fit the context of the sentence.
 
• Option 3: **"in to"** is not a phrase that makes sense in this situation.
 
• Option 4:** "up about"** doesn't align with the intended meaning of the sentence.
